textbookBox.concept: When an object is divided into two equal parts, each part is called a half. We write a half as 1 over 2.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: When an object is divided into two equal parts, each part is called a half. We write a half as 1 over 2. When an object is divided into four equal parts, each part is called a quarter, and we write it as 1 over 4.
beats.speakEn: When an object is divided into two equal parts, each part is called a half. We write a half as 1 over 2. When an object is divided into four equal parts, each part is called a quarter, and we write it as 1 over 4.

beats.en: A rectangle can be folded into two equal parts in many ways: down the middle, across the middle, or along a diagonal. All of these give halves.
beats.speakEn: A rectangle can be folded into two equal parts in many ways: down the middle, across the middle, or along a diagonal. All of these give halves.

textbookBox.concept: Sumedha's mother makes dhokla and asks the children to share it equally. Sumedha and Vinayak each get half. Two halves make a whole dhokla.

beats.en: Sumedha's mother makes dhokla and asks the children to share it equally. Sumedha and Vinayak each get half. Two halves make a whole dhokla.
beats.speakEn: Sumedha's mother makes dhokla and asks the children to share it equally. Sumedha and Vinayak each get half. Two halves make a whole dhokla.

beats.en: If a whole is shared equally among 2 people, each gets 1 over 2. Among 3 people, each gets 1 over 3. Among 4 people, 1 over 4. Among 5, 1 over 5. Among 8, 1 over 8. Among 9, 1 over 9.
beats.speakEn: If a whole is shared equally among 2 people, each gets 1 over 2. Among 3 people, each gets 1 over 3. Among 4 people, 1 over 4. Among 5, 1 over 5. Among 8, 1 over 8. Among 9, 1 over 9.
